sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 129D (Town of Northfield): section 302 provides for a five-member Select Board

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists the Northfield selectboard: Tim Davis, David Maxwell, Lydia Petty, Merry Shernock, and John Stevens

Town of Northfield, Select Board page: lists him as K. David Maxwell (Chair, term to 2027), Merry Shernock (Vice Chair, term to 2027), Lydia Petty (term to 2028), Tim Davis (term to 2028), and John B. Stevens (term to 2029); the board's former chair Charles L. Morse's term ended in 2026 and he no longer sits
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Kim Pedley as Northfield's town clerk
Town of Northfield, 2026 Town Report, Elected Officers table: Kim Pedley, Town Clerk, term to 2027
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Kim Pedley as Northfield's town treasurer
Town of Northfield, 2026 Town Report, Elected Officers table: Kim Pedley, Town Treasurer, term to 2028
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term at the annual meeting

Town of Northfield, 2026 Town Report: the March 2026 warning (Article 1) stood a moderator for a one-year term; the report's Elected Officers table carries Cassie Morse as moderator for a term ended in 2026, and no official source publishes the 2026 outcome, so the post is created without a membership
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of listers of three members on staggered terms
Town of Northfield, Board of Listers page: names only the chair, Thomas Alsheimer

Town of Northfield, 2026 Town Report, Elected Officers table: Thomas Alsheimer (Chair), term to 2027; the other two seats stood at the March 2026 election (a three-year seat and a two-year remainder) and no official source publishes their outcome, so two seats are created without memberships

Town of Northfield, 2026 Town Report, Elected Officers table: the Brown Public Library trustees are elected on the town ballot to a seven-seat board: Gail Hall (term to 2027), Denise MacMartin (term to 2027), Maryann Beaupre (Chair, term to 2028), John B. Stevens (term to 2028), and Kellianne Sutton-Bosley (term to 2028); the two seats that stood in 2026 are unpublished in outcome, so they are created without memberships

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): Northfield elects fourteen justices of the peace; the listing names Anne Donahue, Kenneth Goslant, Jessica Amell, Paul Bean, Richard Wobby, Lea Hatch, Denise Macmartin, Carolyn Stevens, Britta Eberle, Elizabeth Ellsworth, Dexter Rowe, Merry Kay Shernock, Lawrence Garland, and Scott Blanchard
Town of Northfield, 2026 Town Report, Elected Officers table: the town's party-tagged justice of the peace table names the same fourteen justices
